members.name: Karolína Šulcová, DTM
members.responsability: Runs the District’s day-to-day operations, finances and people, leads the District Executive Committee (DEC) and the District Council, and supports every District leader. Works to make the District Distinguished and to prepare the next leader.

members.name: Naza Siminska
members.responsability: Oversees all education and training in the District, including the District conference and the International Speech Contest. Makes sure club officers and Area and Division leaders are well trained and that members reach their education goals.

members.name: Milena Maciuszko
members.responsability: Leads marketing, club-building and club-retention efforts, coaches struggling clubs and protects the Toastmasters brand. Works to grow membership, start new clubs and help weaker clubs become Distinguished.

members.name: Irina Četovičienė
members.responsability: Keeps the District’s official records and writes and shares the minutes of DEC and Council meetings. Makes sure District business is recorded accurately and on time.

members.name: Mercy Kosgei
members.responsability: Manages the District’s budget, payments and assets, and reconciles accounts and submits financial reports on schedule. Makes sure every spending decision is cost-effective and follows policy.

members.name: Dragos Apostol
members.responsability: Plans and leads the District’s communication across the newsletter, website, social media and local media. Raises public awareness of Toastmasters and keeps members informed.

members.name: Irina Četovičienė
members.responsability: Arranges venues, equipment, materials and on-site setup for District events, the conference and contests. Makes sure every event runs smoothly, on time and on budget.

members.name: Mateusz Ryba
members.responsability: Advises the chair on Robert’s Rules of Order, the bylaws and voting procedures during meetings and elections. Makes sure meetings are fair and orderly and decisions are made correctly.

members.name: Piotr Rzeźwicki
members.responsability: Helps clubs and leaders settle disagreements early through mediation and guidance, and passes formal cases to the District Director. Keeps the District environment respectful and positive.

members.name: Mantas Lipnickas
members.responsability: Keeps the District website accurate, up to date and secure, and publishes content from the PR team. Gives members and the public a reliable website that is easy to find their way around.

members.name: Tomáš Motyčka
members.responsability: Runs the District’s online tools, such as meeting platforms, shared drives and forms, and helps leaders use them. Makes the team’s work simpler and more efficient.

members.name: Amani Ratib, DTM
members.responsability: Advises the current District Director and shares experience from the previous year as a member of the DEC. Supports the District Leadership Committee (DLC) in finding future leaders and the Alignment Committee in planning the District’s structure. Gives the District continuity and a strong pipeline of future leaders.

members.name: Magdalena Suraj, DTM
members.responsability: Advises the current District Director and shares experience from the previous year as a member of the DEC. Supports the District Leadership Committee (DLC) in finding future leaders and the Alignment Committee in planning the District’s structure. Gives the District continuity and a strong pipeline of future leaders.
